name: Wizard OS 0.3.82 — 0.3.81 with the fresh-install first run fixed (Welcome, Claude, App Manager)
about: 0.3.81 plus three Recommended fixes found by a standard fresh install on a bare VPS: App Manager #341 (a fresh install no longer stops at the builder mount because of the Hermes override's `networks: !override`), Wizard UX #743 (the Welcome asks to connect an AI on a fresh Wizard instead of skipping to colours) and Claude 0.2.11 / ChatGPT 0.2.9 (wizard-app-store #43: a Claude sign-in on a fresh Wizard becomes the agent's model when it has none).

modes.fresh: blank Ubuntu/Debian box: Runtipi + App Manager + the default app in every spot (including hermes-agent)
modes.alongside: box that already runs Hermes (run as its owner): App Manager + apps + the Wizard shell pointed at that Hermes; `wizard link` connects it, `wizard unlink` reverses it byte for byte

install.note: Fresh and alongside installs both take every default app at the source commit pinned below, and the Wizard UX and Agent Service images at the digests above; the installer reads back what runs (a default app on another source commit fails; index versions are informational and reported as drift). No catalog release is changed by this snapshot.

wizard-app-manager.note: Official main at 5a802723 (merge of #341): c52f260f plus #341 (fix: fresh installs keep the Hermes override's Compose merge tags), #336/#337 and the 0.3.80/0.3.81 mirrors.
